userDecision: On 2026-11-27 the user explicitly chose fixture-only closeout without a real project.
notes: Fixture and isolated pytest evidence do not prove real-project support.
A real project requires an explicit user-named path and a same-configuration temporary copy; the real project remains zero-write.
The user explicitly declined to provide a real project, so PY-11 closed only as supported-fixture-only under ADR-014 section 6.
